Añade el perfil a profiles: en skilus.ya:
Adds the profile to profiles: in skilus.yaml. Its skills must already be
in skills: (install them first with skilus add); without --agent, the
profile is deployed to the detected agents. Installs nothing: use
skilus profile use.
Añade skills o agentes a un perfil: Add skills or agents to a profile
Añade skills, que tienen que estar ya en:
Adds skills, which must already be in skills: of skilus.yaml, and agents
to an existing profile. What the profile already has is left as it is.
Borra el perfil de profiles: en skilus.y:
Deletes the profile from profiles: in skilus.yaml. The installed skills
and their entry in skills: do not change.
Busca en skills.sh y en los índices cura:
Searches skills.sh and the curated indexes declared under indexes: in
skilus.yaml (project and global):

  indexes:
    - https://example.com/skills.yaml

An index is a YAML file with version: 1 and a skills: list of name,
source and description. Its results come first. With a trust: list, each
result says whether its source is trusted. search installs nothing: use
skilus inspect and skilus add with the source it shows.
Busca skills en skills.sh y en los índic: Search skills on skills.sh and in the indexes of skilus.yaml

Consulta, sin descargar contenido, a qué:
Queries, without downloading content, which commit each skill's branch or
tag now points to and compares it with the one in the lock. Skills pinned

updates skilus.lock. skilus.yaml does not change.

Saves the language in ~/.skilus/config.yaml. Accepts a code (es, en, fr…)
or a locale such as pt_BR.UTF-8; auto follows the system again.
Inspecciona e instala skills desde un di: Inspect and install skills from a directory, a Git repository, or a ZIP or tar.gz
Inspecciona las skills de un origen sin: Inspect the skills of a source without installing anything
Instala cada skill de skilus.lock en sus:
Installs every skill in skilus.lock into its agents, downloading it by its
commit if the store does not have it, and fails if its hash does not match
the lock. It changes neither skilus.lock nor skilus.yaml.

If an installed skill was modified by hand, it touches nothing and warns;
with --force it overwrites it.
Instala las skills del perfil que faltan:
Installs the profile's missing skills, from the source recorded in
skilus.yaml and with the same inspection as skilus add; moves those already
installed to the profile's agents, if it declares any; and retires from the
agents and from skilus.lock those the profile does not include. skilus.yaml
does not change, so switching back to the previous profile reinstalls the
same thing.
Lee las skills del origen y muestra lo m:
Reads the skills of the source and shows the same as skilus add before
asking: files, size, hash, executables and findings. Exits with code 5 if
add would refuse to install them (blocking findings, or warnings with
--strict).
Lee las skills del origen, las inspeccio:
Reads the skills of the source, inspects them and, after you confirm,
installs them into the detected agents (or those given with --agent).
Records the result in skilus.lock and the intent in skilus.yaml.

The source can be a directory (./skills), a Git repository
(owner/repo[@ref] or a URL) or a ZIP or tar.gz archive over https. Inside,
one skill (with SKILL.md at its root) or skills in skills/<name>/ or
<name>/.
Lista las skills instaladas con su commi: List installed skills with their commit, hash and agents
Lista los agentes soportados y cuáles es: List supported agents and which are installed
Lista los perfiles y marca el activo: List profiles and mark the active one
Muestra la ayuda de cualquier comando de: Shows help for any skilus command.
Muestra o cambia el idioma en que skilus: Show or change the language skilus writes in
Para cada skill de skilus.lock comprueba:
For each skill in skilus.lock, checks whether its source is in trust:,
whether the pinned commit is signed and the signature can be verified (with
your git keys or, on GitHub, with the keys GitHub knows) and re-inspects
the content with the current heuristics. Executables accepted at install
time are not reported again.

Exits with code 5 if there are blocking findings, or warnings with
--strict, so it can be used in CI.
Quita skills de sus agentes, de skilus.y: Remove skills from their agents, skilus.yaml and the lock
Quita skills o agentes de un perfil: Remove skills or agents from a profile
Quita skills y agentes de un perfil. Las:
Removes skills and agents from a profile. The skills stay in skills: of
skilus.yaml and, if installed, in the agents: the next skilus profile use
retires them. If you remove every agent, the profile is deployed to the
detected agents.
Recalcula el hash de cada skill en cada:
Recomputes the hash of each skill in each agent and compares it with
skilus.lock. Exits with code 6 if any is missing or any file has changed,
and says which.
Revisa lo instalado con las reglas de ho: Review what is installed against today's rules: trust, signatures and inspection

Sin argumentos, muestra el idioma que us:
Without arguments, shows the language skilus uses, where it comes from and
the available ones. By default it follows the system: LANGUAGE, LC_ALL,
LC_MESSAGES and LANG (on Windows, the user's language). If none of them is
available, it uses English. The SKILUS_LANG variable overrides everything
else.
Todo en orden: %d skill(s) en %d destino: All good: %d skill(s) in %d target(s) match the lock.
Un perfil es un conjunto de skills de sk:
A profile is a set of skills from skilus.yaml and, optionally, the
agents they are deployed to:

  profiles:
    backend:
      skills: [systematic-debugging, mcp-builder]
      agents: [claude-code]
    web:
      skills: [systematic-debugging, web-design-guidelines]

skilus profile create, add, remove and delete edit that section without
touching the rest of the file. skilus profile use deploys a profile and
retires what does not belong to it.
